english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for one half of a school or academic year.

exampleSentences.english: I have five courses to take this semester.
exampleSentences.traditional: 今個學期我有五科要讀。
exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 go3 hok6 kei4 ngo5 jau5 ng5 fo1 jiu3 duk6

english.note: Use this specifically for one division of an academic year.

exampleSentences.english: I have four subjects to take this term.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個學期我有四科要讀。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 hok6 kei4 ngo5 jau5 sei3 fo1 jiu3 duk6
